li.label: a good shift
li.description: Guests kept coming to the counter and I had something to do the whole time. That is how work should feel.

li.label: a busy shift
li.description: One guest after the other. I knew every order before they finished asking. A good kind of tired.

li.label: rushed off my feet
li.description: The whole room wanted something at once and I kept up with all of it. I'm proud of that shift.

li.label: bored at the counter
li.description: I stood behind the counter for ages and nobody came. I polished the same glass three times.

li.label: stood around all shift
li.description: Hours at the counter with nothing to do. I could have been doing something useful.

li.label: a pointless shift
li.description: An entire shift of waiting for guests who never came. What am I even standing here for?
